feasibility.label: feasibility: each requirement is tested on its own measurement; no score offsets a failure

assumptions: Additive aggregation: a poor score on one criterion can be fully compensated by a good score on another (compensatory model).
Preferential independence: preferences on one criterion do not depend on the levels of the others, so an additive form is appropriate.
Partial values are normalised to [0, 1] over the stated scale range; weights are swing weights over those same ranges.
Missing measurements are not imputed; the model must be complete to be evaluated.
result.weight_basis: Swing weights: each rating expresses the importance of the swing from the worst to the best level of that criterion over the stated scale range, not abstract importance. Changing a scale range changes the meaning of its weight.
